exposure: Type of delivery: simple, complicated vaginal, and cesarean
outcome: Cost of obstetric and neonatal care
Impact on maternal and neonatal health
cohort: 411 women who gave birth at 10 referral hospitals in Lubumbashi, Democratic Republic of Congo, and paid out-of-pocket for obstetric and neonatal care
finding: High costs of obstetric and neonatal care in Lubumbashi, exceeding 40% of the ability to pay for 58.4% of households, led to prolonged hospital stays, reduced household income, family conflicts, and negative impacts on maternal and neonatal health.
mod_finding: Costs for obstetric and neonatal care averaged US $77, US $207 and US $338 for simple, complicated vaginal and caesarean deliveries, respectively.
